$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F03 GCD detail (A6): the right temple at the hinge, close and from above, framed on the hinge. The engraved wordmark and old emblem come off stroke by stroke. The GCD is placed with tools/photo/temple_gcd.py: seen from above, the temple's edges are nearly parallel, so the old print's proportions give the foreshortening along it; the render is tilted to the face's angle for its shading.

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges)
